claims.summary: Combinatorial address decoder or data mux that selects OP_D from multiple internal OPx sources based on address inputs IP_A and OP_A.
claims.subject: m3s009fd
claims.explanation: The module has no event inputs, no control inputs, no instances, and no internal event flows. The only assign drives OP_D from a 16-way OR of OP0-OP15. The data inputs IP_A and OP_A are 4-bit addresses, and IP_D is an 8-bit data input. This strongly suggests a combinatorial decode/mux structure where IP_A and OP_A select one of 16 internal OPx values to drive OP_D, and IP_D may be routed to one of the OPx lines.
